blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Abstracting structured buildings from limited observations is essential for 3D urban modeling and digital twins. Partial point clouds and overhead images of the same building provide incomplete 3D surface measurements and visual cues to its footprint, roof geometry, and rooftop structures, respectively. This motivates a unified framework that aligns geometric and visual cues in 3D and reconstructs buildings from either or both modalities. Building on this connection, we present Any2Building, a unified model for Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) building reconstruction from partial point clouds, overhead images, or both, with optional coarse geometric priors. At its core is an occupancy-grounded shared spatial queries representation that organizes available observations within a common 3D grid. Supervised by complete building surface voxels, these queries connect observational evidence to target geometry, enabling a shared generator to learn structural priors across tasks and providing spatial guidance for recovering missing structure. A trained voxel conditional surface-generation and low-poly remeshing pipeline then converts the predicted structure into compact LoD2 building models. To support this framework, we introduce BuildingWorld-Image, comprising approximately one million paired samples of partial point clouds, overhead images, and LoD2 building models across 18 cities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Any2Building outperforms existing methods in geometric reconstruction accuracy across unimodal and multimodal point-cloud completion, single-image building generation, and prior-assisted generation, while maintaining detailed and robust recovery when point cloud input modality is degraded.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Structured 3D building models support urban digital twins [ 2 ] and applications such as urban understanding [ 43 ] and visual localization [ 44 ] .
Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) modeling [ 17 ] captures a building’s spatial organization in a compact, structured
representation that preserves the geometry and spatial relationships
of its roof sections and detailed rooftop structures.
Building reconstruction often relies on limited observations, including
partial point clouds [ 13 , 16 , 22 , 15 ] and overhead images [ 30 , 18 ] .
Point clouds provide partial geometric measurements, while
overhead images reveal appearance and layout but leave height
and hidden surfaces ambiguous.
Although these heterogeneous observations can originate
from the same building, point cloud based building
reconstruction and image-based building generation
are still largely treated as separate tasks.
This common origin motivates a unified reconstruction
framework that recovers LoD2 building
from either modality independently or their combination.

blocks.en:
To address this challenge, we introduce Any2Building ,
a unified LoD2 building reconstruction model
that supports point cloud input and remote sensing
image inputs, together with height or box priors.
Our main technical innovation is a set of shared queries initialized on a low-resolution 3D voxel grid. The available inputs are encoded as conditioning tokens, and shared
spatial queries aggregate their features at common 3D locations.
Supervision with complete building surface voxels encourages the queries
to capture the overall building structure, including unobserved regions,
before they condition the generator.
By relating different observations to the same underlying
geometry, the queries further guide the generator,
enabling shared structural learning across point-cloud
completion and image-based generation, together with optional coarse geometric priors. The generated structure latent is decoded into a voxel grid.
We find that these voxels alone suffice for continuous
mesh reconstruction by a trained surface generator,
without additional point or image conditioning.
Low-poly remeshing and texturing then produce compact Lod2 building assets.

Multimodal methods, including EGIInet [ 36 ] ,

diffusion with autoregressive mesh generation, while

jointly predict point geometry and assembly-ready primitives
non-autoregressively. Both rely on observed 3D geometry through voxelized point
conditioning and shared point cloud features. Incorporating images therefore requires an additional
mechanism to spatially ground 2D appearance.

blocks.en:
Recent image-to-3D models, including TRELLIS, TRELLIS.2,
and SAM 3D [ 31 , 32 , 1 ] ,
provide strong generative priors for recovering geometry
from visual observations.
At the building level, BuilDiff [ 30 ] generates point clouds through single-image-conditioned
diffusion, while SatSkylines [ 18 ] introduces geometric control by interpolating coarse-prior
latents with Gaussian noise.
However, extending this noise-space injection to partial
point clouds can obscure fine geometric cues, while coupling

control over local structure.
Related urban generation methods synthesize larger scenes
through compositional modeling [ 35 , 19 ] and satellite-conditioned
generation [ 12 , 14 , 24 , 29 ] .
Overhead appearance nevertheless leaves height and hidden
surfaces ambiguous, while coarse priors do not specify
detailed architectural geometry.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Any2Building generates LoD2 buildings from a partial point
cloud P P , an overhead image I I , or both, with an optional
coarse geometric prior R R .
Its central component is a set of shared spatial queries
that aggregate observations on a low-resolution 3D grid.
Supervised by complete building occupancy, these queries
form an intermediate representation of overall structure
before conditioning the generator.
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , the query features
guide a flow-matching DiT through query-enhanced (QE) tokens
and spatial prompts.
The generated structure is decoded into a 64 3 64^{3} surface-voxel grid and converted into a compact LoD2 mesh.
All geometric inputs, spatial queries, and output voxel
grids share a normalized building coordinate system
linked to the georeferenced overhead imagery.
This allows generated
buildings to be aligned with the source imagery and
mapped back to their real-world locations, even in
the image-only setting.

blocks.en: Our BuildingWorld-Image contains 1,011,196 real overhead-image–low-poly mesh pairs across 18 cities before splitting, with approximately one million pairs used for training. The test set contains 2,000 buildings from unseen cities and held-out regions within training cities. Coarse priors are constructed from bounding boxes or height-extruded footprints. Subsets with textured ground-truth meshes support appearance evaluation through matched four-view renderings, with Hong Kong examples shown in Fig. 4 . blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Any2Building, a unified model for LoD2 building
reconstruction from partial point clouds, overhead images, or both.
The model also supports image-based reconstruction with coarse geometric
priors. Supervised by complete-building surface occupancy, our shared
spatial queries aggregate input features on a common 3D grid and
condition the same structure generator across input settings.
We generate surfaces from the predicted voxels alone and remesh them
into compact LoD2 models. We also introduced BuildingWorld-Image, comprising approximately one
million aligned triplets of partial point clouds, overhead images,
and LoD2 building meshes across 18 cities.
Experiments show improved reconstruction accuracy across unimodal and
multimodal point-cloud completion, single-image generation, and
prior-assisted generation. Ablations show that joint training improves
reconstruction from either modality alone, and that adding imagery
improves completion from sparse or spatially incomplete point clouds.

blocks.en: A.2 Geographically Grounded Associations

blocks.en: Source meshes use different coordinate systems, units, local origins, and axis conventions. We retain source metadata and recover the transform from local geometry to the geographic image frame before extracting instance observations. Coordinate projection, axis order, local offsets, and units are resolved in this transformation chain. The image affine mapping is updated after cropping, padding, and resizing so that pixel spacing continues to represent the correct physical extent. Meshes and partial points are placed in the same upright building coordinate frame for training. Source-to-geographic transforms remain attached to the association rather than being inferred from normalized geometry.
blocks.zh: 源代码使用不同的坐标系统、单位、本地起源和轴公约。 我们保留源元数据,并在提取实例观测之前恢复从局部几何学到地理图像框架的转变. 坐标投影,轴序,局部偏移,单位在此变换链中解决. 在裁剪,粘贴,再缩放后更新图像的afine映射,使像素间距继续代表正确的物理范围. Meshes和部分点被放置在同一直立的建筑坐标架上进行训练. 源到地理的变换仍然附着在协会身上,而不是从正常的几何学推断出来.

blocks.en: A building’s geographic extent defines a context window in an orthophoto or remote-sensing mosaic. We retain the image-to-world transformation and available source metadata. Municipal orthophotos and mixed aerial/satellite basemaps are both used; consequently, we describe the collection as overhead remote-sensing imagery rather than assuming a uniform satellite sensor. The context preserves neighboring structures, while an instance mask focuses attention on the target.
blocks.zh: 建筑物的地理范围定义了正交或遥感的上下文窗口。 我们保留图像到世界的转换和现有的源元数据。 城市正反摄影图和混合的航空/卫星基图都得到使用;因此,我们把收集的图像描述为超高遥感图象,而不是假设一个统一的卫星传感器。 上下文保留了邻近的结构,而实例面具则将注意力集中在目标上.

blocks.en:
We project the source building geometry into the geographic window to initialize an instance mask. RGB context, mask, and cutout are stored as related observations of the same target. Partial point clouds use available measurements or source-derived simulations according to their source pool. Coarse geometric conditions include bounding volumes and footprint-derived prisms. A prior that uses target-derived height is distinguished from one derived entirely from external observations; it is not treated as free information in image-only reconstruction. The projected instance mask is not supplied as an additional
condition in the single-image setting.

The projected instance mask and its bounding box are distinct
annotations: storing a mask does not imply that background
removal is applied in every input setting.
Our image-based evaluation therefore assumes ground-truth-derived
instance localization and measures reconstruction given an
instance crop, rather than end-to-end building detection
and reconstruction. Although this is sufficient for single-building generation, we are also exploring, at this stage, the use of agents to automate the entire city-scale generation pipeline.

blocks.en: A.3 Quality Screening and Refinement

blocks.en: Quality screening checks native resolution, foreground coverage, exposure, texture, and orientation. Resolution tiers use the source image before resampling; enlarging a crop does not add evidence or improve its tier. Context and cutout variants share the same image window, padding, and display scale, with only the instance mask differing.
blocks.zh: 质量筛查检查本地分辨率,前期覆盖,曝光,纹理,定向. 分辨率分级在重新复制前使用源图像; 拓宽一个作物不会添加证据或改善其分级 。 上下文和剪切变体共享相同的图像窗口,粘贴,显示尺度,只有实例遮罩不同.

blocks.en: Systematic scale disagreement is first diagnosed in the coordinate conversion, rather than absorbed by a per-building image fit. Incorrect map projection, confusion between meters and feet, or a stale pixel-to-world scale after crop resizing can affect every target from a source. Our Boston repair restores the local offset and the source survey-foot convention. The inspected Cambridge export additionally requires a source-specific scale factor; it is not a universal correction for Cambridge data. These corrections belong to the shared source-to-world transform and are checked against geographic context before local alignment.
blocks.zh: 系统尺度的分歧首先在坐标转换中被诊断出来,而不是被每个构造的图像合体吸收. 地图投影不正确,米和脚之间的混淆,或者作物重新大小后一个沉积的像素到世界尺度,可以从一个来源影响每个目标. 我们的波士顿修复 恢复了当地的抵消 和源调查脚会议。 被检查的剑桥出口还需要一个特定来源的尺度系数;对于剑桥数据来说,这不是一个普遍的校正。 这些更正属于共同的源对世界的转变,在当地调整之前根据地理背景加以检查。

blocks.en: A visible roof boundary, an eave outline, and a ground footprint need not coincide. Projecting a source mesh into an image can also disagree with visible edges because an oblique acquisition displaces elevated surfaces relative to the ground, with different roof levels shifting differently. Occlusion and differences in acquisition date introduce further discrepancies. A single isotropic scale cannot generally resolve these effects. We therefore distinguish coordinate calibration from correspondence refinement, retain the meaning of each contour, and flag ambiguous roof–footprint matches instead of treating every residual as a scale error.
blocks.zh: 可见的屋顶界限、轮廓和地面足迹不需要重合。 将一个源网投射成图像也可能与可见的边缘产生分歧,因为斜面获取会取代相对于地面的高地表,不同的屋顶水平变化不同. 购置日期的重叠和差异造成进一步的差异。 单一的异热带尺度一般无法解决这些影响。 因此,我们将坐标校准与通信改进区分开来,保留每个轮廓的含义,并标出模糊的屋顶-脚印匹配,而不是将每个剩余部分当作尺度错误处理。

blocks.en: After geographic calibration, local refinement addresses residual contour displacement where the projected and visible boundaries are compatible. Our refinement proposal searches a bounded translation and isotropic scale around the registered contour. For contour point p p and its center c c , the candidate transform is T ⁡ ( p ) = s ⁡ ( p − c ) + c + t T(p)=s(p-c)+c+t . The objective combines orientation-compatible image-edge distance with penalties on translation t t and scale s s , preserving the source polygon rather than reclassifying foreground pixels. The transformation preserves polygon components, vertex ordering, and corners, avoiding the erosion of roof structure that unconstrained image segmentation can introduce. We retain a proposal only when it improves the edge objective and remains inside the image; otherwise the registered prior is kept. Successive refinement passes record their cumulative scale, so a bound relative to an intermediate contour is not confused with a bound relative to the source geometry. Figure S2 shows examples.
blocks.zh: 在地理校准后,当地改进处理预测和可见边界相容的剩余轮廓迁移问题。 我们的完善提案 搜索一个界限 和异热带尺度 围绕注册的轮廓。 对于轮廓点p及其中心c c ,候选变换为 T → (p) = s → (p − c) + c + t T(p) → s(p-c) + c+ t. 目标结合了定向兼容的图像尖端距离和对翻译 t t 和 scale s 的处罚,保留了源多边形,而不是将前置像素重新分类. 转变保留了多边形组件,顶点顺序,以及角,避免了不受限制的图像分割可以引入的屋顶结构的侵蚀. 我们只保留一项改进边缘目标并留在图像内的提案;否则,登记在案的先被保留。 连续的修饰通过记录了它们的累积尺度,因此相对于中间轮廓的束缚不会与相对于源几何的束缚混淆. 图S2显示了实例。

blocks.en: Refinement preserves vector-contour structure and retains the registered prior when a proposed update fails the acceptance criteria. No independent pixel annotations are available for this refinement, so the examples do not establish a mask-IoU improvement. Difficult cases involving occlusion, multiple roof levels, building groups, or an incorrect source contour remain subject to review.

blocks.en: All three studies in Table 4 use the full 2,000-building BuildingWorld-Image test set. Geometric metrics are evaluated on the final low-poly meshes produced by the reconstruction procedure specified for each study, using the shared evaluation frame and metric definitions in Appendix B.2 . F-score uses a normalized distance threshold of 0.02, and CD L ​ 1 \mathrm{CD}_{L1} is reported with a scale factor of 10 3 10^{3} . Component variants are compared within each input setting in panel (a); the paired contribution of imagery is evaluated separately in panel (b). In the surface-generation study, both the structure-only and surface-stage variants are converted to low-poly meshes using the indicated backend before evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表4中的所有三项研究都采用了完整的2000年建筑世界-图像测试集. 利用附录B.2中的共同评价框架和计量定义,对每项研究中指定的重建程序产生的最后低孔膜进行几何计量。 F-score使用正常距离阈值为0.02,CD L 1\mathrm{CD}_{L1}报告比例为10 3 10^{3}。 在(a)面板的每个投入设置中,对组成部分的变体进行比较;在(b)面板中分别评价成对图像的贡献。 在地表生成研究中,仅结构变体和地表级变体均在评价前使用指定的后端转换成低波层间质.

blocks.en: The condition concat baseline replaces the spatial-query conditioning design with direct concatenation of the available input tokens. Point and image tokens are included according to the input setting, and encoded prior tokens are also concatenated in the I+R setting. The resulting sequence directly conditions the DiT, without query read-back or spatial-prompt injection. This baseline therefore compares the complete spatial-query conditioning design with direct token conditioning while retaining access to the available input modalities and priors.
blocks.zh: 条件concat基线用现有输入符的直接调制取代空间-query调制设计. 点和映像符按照输入设置包含,编码的前缀也在I+R设置中进行调色. 由此产生的序列直接为DiT提供了条件,没有查询回读或空间瞬间注射. 因此,这一基线将完整的空间-冷却调节设计与直接的信号调节进行对比,同时保留对现有输入方式和前置设备的访问。

blocks.en: The remaining variants remove one component at a time. The w/o occupancy supervision variant omits the auxiliary query occupancy loss while retaining the query representation and the remaining generation objectives. The w/o query read-back variant uses the base condition tokens H H directly, i.e., H QE = H H_{\mathrm{QE}}=H , while retaining query occupancy supervision and spatial prompts. The w/o spatial prompts variant removes the aligned residual injection into the DiT while retaining query-enhanced condition tokens and occupancy supervision. Each variant is retrained using the same training protocol; the components are not simply disabled in the trained full model at inference.
blocks.zh: 其余的变体一次移除一个组件. w/o占用监理变体省略了辅助查询占用损失,同时保留了查询说明和剩余的生成目标. w/o查询读后变体使用基条件符H直接H,即HQE=H_{\mathrm{QE}}=H,同时保留查询占用监管和空间提示. w/o空间提示变体取消了向DiT的对齐残留注射,同时保留了查询增强的条件符和占用监管. 每个变体都使用同样的训练规程进行再训练;在经过训练的完整模型中,构件不是简单的被禁用,推论。

blocks.en: We train one specialist for each of P, I, P+I, and I+R, using the corresponding architecture and inference inputs. Each specialist and the joint model receive the same number of optimizer updates. The joint model samples the four input modes with equal probability, whereas each specialist uses only its designated mode. The comparison therefore matches the total update count per model rather than the number of training exposures to each mode. At evaluation, the joint model and the corresponding specialist receive the same type of input; joint training does not introduce extra inference modalities into the P-only or I-only comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们利用相应的架构和推论投入,为P、I、P+I和I+R各培训一名专家。 每个专家和联合模型都得到同样数量的优化更新。 联合模型对四种输入模式进行相同概率的取样,而每个专家只使用其指定模式。 因此,这一比较与每个模式的更新总数相符,而不是每个模式的培训次数。 在评价时,联合模型和相应的专家得到的输入类型相同;联合培训不引入仅P类或I类的推断模式.

blocks.en: The image-contribution study uses the same trained checkpoint for P and P+I inference. The None setting uses the original 2,048-point partial observation without additional degradation; it does not denote a complete building point cloud. Random degradation retains 205 or 41 points from this observation. Spatial degradation adapts the ShapeNet-55 cropping scheme used by AdaPoinTr [ 39 ] . A randomly selected spatial region is first removed, after which the remaining observations are subsampled to 41 points. Thus, spatial removal precedes subsampling, and the 41-point input is not obtained by directly cropping away all but 41 points. Comparing this setting with random subsampling to the same count examines the role of spatial coverage under equally sparse observations.
blocks.zh: 图像贡献研究对P和P+I推论使用相同的训练有素的检查站. None设置使用原有的2,048点部分观测,没有额外的降解;并不表示完整的建筑点云. 随机降解从这一观察中保留了205或41分. 空间退化适应了AdaPoinTr使用的ShapeNet-55作物种植计划[39]. 随机选择的空间区首先被移除,之后剩下的观测结果被分解为41点. 因此,空间去除先于子采样,41点输入不是通过直接切除除除41点以外的全部来得到的. 将这种设置与随机的子取样与同一计数相比较,可以研究空间覆盖在同样稀少的观测下的作用。

blocks.en: For every comparison, P and P+I use identical retained points, normalization, and generation noise; P+I additionally receives the paired overhead image. Degradation is applied before resampling to the encoder input size, so repeated samples do not add geometric observations. The reported point counts refer to the retained observations rather than the length of the resampled encoder input.

blocks.en: C.1 Point-Cloud Encoder Ablation
blocks.zh: C.1 圆点编码器

blocks.en:
We compare different point-cloud conditioning encoders on
Building-PCC while keeping the spatial-query module and
generation pipeline fixed.
Specifically, we replace EdgeConv with a pointwise MLP,
a Point Transformer, or the TRELLIS.2 VAE
encoder [ 32 ] .
The point-based variants use the same sampled centers,
whereas the VAE encoder extracts conditioning features from
voxelized partial observations.
All encoder outputs are adapted to the same token count
and feature width.
We additionally remove the additive positional embedding
from the EdgeConv tokens to isolate its contribution
while retaining local neighborhood aggregation.
All variants follow the same training split, optimization
budget, and evaluation protocol.
Table S3 compares point-cloud completion
and downstream low-poly reconstruction to assess the effects
of local geometry encoding, voxel-based conditioning,
and explicit point localization.

blocks.zh: C.2 空间查询设计和分辨率

blocks.en:
To examine the spatial granularity of the query design,
we compare 8 3 8^{3} and 16 3 16^{3} query lattices through

matching the number of additional optimizer steps.
The coarser query field is interpolated to the generator’s 16 3 16^{3} latent grid, while the output resolution remains 64 3 64^{3} in both variants. Query supervision and prior
aggregation follow the query resolution, so this
experiment evaluates the spatial-query configuration
as a whole rather than query count alone.
